# Angela Save Priority Draft

This draft ranks Angela pairings by map leverage instead of clip value.

## What to watch

- Track which anchors convert rescue into territory.
- Measure whether assassin pairings win fast or burn reliability.
- Keep data on who preserves Angela's agency after first contact.

## Draft focus

If the pairing cannot buy tempo, it may be spectacular but not editorially strong.

> The rescue matters only if it buys the map something real.

More on Angela: keep this read connected to support roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
